title: Sunrise Suntan | KEY.co
description_expanded: Discover the epitome of coastal luxury at this 30A Beach House, a stunning five-bedroom retreat designed for both relaxation and adventure. The spacious living area invites gatherings with its seventy-five-inch TV, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar ensures delightful culinary experiences. Each bedroom offers a unique haven of comfort, featuring king or queen beds, en suite bathrooms, and sixty-five-inch TVs for ultimate entertainment. The fifth bedroom, complete with two full-over-full bunks, is perfect for accommodating larger groups. Modern amenities, including a full-size washer and dryer, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and a convenient half bathroom on the main level, cater to every need. Step outside to embrace the enchanting outdoor spaces, from the large front porch to multiple decks and balconies, perfect for savoring the coastal breeze. The provided four-seater golf cart makes exploring the picturesque surroundings a breeze. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower before unwinding in the serene ambiance of this exquisite home. With a two-car garage and ample sleeping arrangements for up to sixteen guests, this 30A Beach House is the ultimate destination for creating unforgettable memories.
